title: Session order · round 1
intro: Claude Design, 16 Nov. Three directions, drawn on the same 20 seconds from your screenshots: Keep-awake lands and starts its Land review, one session finishes, one asks for git fetch, cron starts a new session in main, agents keep calling tools.

A · Ledger: one stable worktree tree on both clients, oldest first, new sessions go last; state is only a filter chip. B · Gated feed: today's shapes with the sort fixed, every move waits behind a Show pill. C · Inbox over a ledger (designer's pick): A's tree plus a Needs you inbox on top; nothing you can see moves on its own.
